criteria.task: Validate the bounded queue with forced enrollment schedules, supported ThreadSanitizer and a fixed-seed stress workload. Preserve a known race/logical mutant as a sensitivity control and classify unsupported instrumentation distinctly.

reasoning: Running the same stress repeatedly explores every schedule. Refute this explanation with the smallest relevant state or execution.

deliverables.D1: Pre-experiment prediction and causal argument addressing: Running the same stress repeatedly explores every schedule.
deliverables.D2: Validate the bounded queue with forced enrollment schedules, supported ThreadSanitizer and a fixed-seed stress workload. Preserve a known race/logical mutant as a sensitivity control and classify unsupported instrumentation distinctly.
deliverables.D3: Exact commands or derivation steps, original inputs, observed outputs, a minimized disagreement and an independent control for this leaf. Retain unsupported-tool/target outcomes separately.
deliverables.D4: Port to a weakly ordered target or model and identify ordering failures the original host may rarely expose.

verification.procedure: Predict the specified result first; execute or derive the concrete task within the shared and parent contracts. Record implementation/target versions and all source dependencies.
verification.expected: Deterministic tests target named interleavings; race detection is execution/instrumentation bounded; stress adds observed samples only.
verification.pass: Every task clause and the expected causal argument must be supported by the actual learner artifact/trace. A matching number with the stated misconception, missing ownership boundary or unsupported target claim fails this objective.
verification.limits: Authored per-leaf work is unattempted. Named laboratory anchors cover only their explicit cases. Newly executed lifecycle tests are assessor-reference evidence, not learner completion or the full project.
